evidence.claim: IWT realizza a Varese, su oltre 20.000 mq di produzione, soluzioni di lavaggio, isolamento e decontaminazione per farmaceutico, nutraceutico e cosmetico.
evidence.quote: IWT offers a comprehensive range of cleaning, isolation, and decontamination solutions for the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic markets, and related industries. || Our manufacturing base in Varese, just a few kilometers away from Milan Malpensa International Airport, spans over 20,000 square meters (215,000 square feet) of production areas || IWT – GMP solutions for cleaning, sterile isolation, decontamination and ATMPs in pharmaceutical, biotech and Cell & Gene Therapy sectors.
